title: Diner Rules
summary: Panam buys V a meal at a roadside diner and orders for both of them. V has to guess what she ordered.
description: Panam is hungry, and she is buying. She wants V to come to the roadside diner at the Old Turbine Farm road junction and let her order for both of them.

start.bringUp: You are hungry and you are buying, and you mean it. Bring up, in your own way, that V should come to the diner at the Old Turbine Farm road junction and let you order.

variations.know: It is breakfast, and Panam has ordered the whole menu in her head.
variations.wants: V to guess the order from her description.

variations.know: It is midnight and the cook is still awake, and he has opinions about Panam.
variations.wants: V to ask the cook what he thinks she ordered.

variations.know: A storm has them stuck in the diner, and the jukebox keeps playing the same song.
variations.wants: V to pick a different song and guess the order.

diner.name: the roadside diner at the Old Turbine Farm road junction

counter.name: the counter stool where Panam orders for both of you

g1.asks: Tell me something you're bad at. I've told you plenty.
g1.know: Panam has ordered for both of you, and V guesses what she ordered from her description.
g1.secret: She likes being the one who orders.

stages.label: Panam orders for both of you at the diner counter
stages.objective: Guess what Panam ordered at the diner counter
stages.know: V is at the roadside diner. Panam has ordered for both of you, and V must guess what she ordered from her description.
stages.wants: V to guess the order, once.

ate.memory: You ate at the diner with Panam and guessed what she ordered, or came close enough that she let it count.

left.memory: You left the diner before Panam finished ordering for you.

stood-up.memory: You never came to the diner, and Panam ate both meals herself.
